purpose: Put Mythical Void where people are already choosing a new game without accidentally giving away distribution rights or launching with weak visual proof.

recommendation.now: Keep both the Poki-first and itch.io-first options open while Game Development improves the opening experience and four authentic gameplay moments are approved.
recommendation.afterVisualGate: Ask Kevin to choose between requesting Poki access first or publishing the prepared itch.io release. The recommended order for maximum upside is a bounded Poki access request first, with itch.io as the ready fallback if Poki is not a fit or acceptable terms are not offered.
recommendation.why: Poki says its preferred partnership is web-exclusive and can include platform marketing. Publishing on another web portal first can move the game into Poki's non-exclusive flat-fee route. The itch.io build is already ready, so preserving the larger option costs no technical rework while the visual gate is closed.
recommendation.decisionDue: Only after the 4/4 visual gate, first-minute play review, mobile and desktop check, and rights review pass.

technicalAssessment.openingReview: One clear FIRST CONTACT egg interaction reached immediately on desktop and phone in a private local review.

primaryFork.name: Poki-first reach bet
primaryFork.bestFor: A chance at much larger curated web reach and platform marketing.
entryRequirements: A game with a strong core loop, first impression and cross-device feel
Fast loading, stable performance and a lean web build
A full-bleed square thumbnail that closely matches the actual game
A named person, email, studio, country and live game link for the access request
Commercial and legal review before accepting any exclusivity, advertising, SDK or revenue terms
primaryFork.tradeoff: Slower and selective; a preferred deal can restrict other web portals for an indicative five years, with exact terms set by agreement.

primaryFork.name: itch.io-first learning bet
primaryFork.bestFor: The fastest low-cost route to a real indie game shelf and early player learning.
entryRequirements: A truthful cover and three to five real game images
Kevin-controlled account and approval of the public page and platform terms
primaryFork.tradeoff: Faster learning and control, but publishing elsewhere can reduce the value of a later Poki approach.

secondaryRoutes.name: YouTube Playables
secondaryRoutes.role: Let a general-audience 13+ player discover and start the game directly inside YouTube.
secondaryRoutes.rule: Do not submit or relabel the family game. Require an honest general-audience 13+ decision, a separate no-network build, YouTube saving and lifecycle controls, touch and resize proof, cleared rights, approved authentic visuals, an official channel and Kevin approval.

secondaryRoutes.name: YouTube
secondaryRoutes.role: Show authentic gameplay to people comparing games before trying one.
secondaryRoutes.rule: No trailers or Shorts made from the withdrawn captures or from imagined art presented as gameplay.

secondaryRoutes.name: Newgrounds
secondaryRoutes.role: A direct HTML5 game shelf with an established games community.
secondaryRoutes.rule: New submissions face public judgment and can be removed for a low score; use only after the first minutes, rights, credits and presentation are strong.

secondaryRoutes.name: r/WebGames and relevant browser-game communities
secondaryRoutes.role: Human discussion with people who deliberately try browser games.
secondaryRoutes.rule: Do not treat a community as a free advert board. Lead with the playable experience and human craft, disclose AI honestly, read current rules immediately before posting, and do not use automated promotional copy.

secondaryRoutes.name: Game Jolt
secondaryRoutes.role: A game page plus ongoing creator/community activity.
secondaryRoutes.rule: Do not create a profile or promise browser-package support until the current signed-in add-game flow and terms are checked.

secondaryRoutes.name: CrazyGames
secondaryRoutes.rule: Require current SDK, privacy, advertising, audience, rights and commercial review before any submission.

secondaryRoutes.name: Steam
secondaryRoutes.role: A later downloadable release with strong buying intent.
secondaryRoutes.rule: Revisit only with a downloadable product, store plan, fee and support capacity.

qualityGates: 4 of 4 authentic gameplay moments approved by a person
The creature remains clearly visible and alive during real play
The first meaningful action is understandable without a long explanation
The packaged game loads reliably on desktop and mobile
All public images match what a player will actually experience
Music, art, code and AI-use disclosures are ready for the chosen platform
